original_intent: Continue Decapod cloud integration after Dactyl v0.9.0 and merged Propodus cloud hardening; repair release PR and master action failures in the same PR.
derived_intent: Upgrade the Dactyl dependency, preserve the thin backend=cloud boundary, make todo state plus event changes atomic, and make CI distinguish release PRs from ordinary master promotion.
active_boundaries: Decapod owns routing, transitions, events, workflow gating, and proof; Dactyl owns storage transport/execution; Propodus owns auth, tenancy, and deployed cloud parity; Neon/Vercel live proof is deferred.
repo_scope: Decapod source, tests, docs, living specs, governance artifacts, and GitHub workflow/release validation files in one PR
